# istio_service_entry (Resource)

Manages an Istio ServiceEntry resource. ServiceEntries add external services or internal services not auto-discovered to the mesh's service registry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "istio_service_entry" "external_api" {
  manifest = jsonencode({
    apiVersion = "networking.istio.io/v1"
    kind       = "ServiceEntry"
    metadata = {
      name      = "external-api"
      namespace = "default"
    }
    spec = {
      hosts    = ["api.external-service.com"]
      location = "MESH_EXTERNAL"
      ports = [
        {
          number   = 443
          name     = "https"
          protocol = "TLS"
        }
      ]
      resolution = "DNS"
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `manifest` (String) Full ServiceEntry manifest as a JSON string. Must include `apiVersion`, `kind`, `metadata.name`, and `metadata.namespace`. The `apiVersion` in the manifest determines which API version is used (e.g. `networking.istio.io/v1` or an older version like `v1beta1`). Sensitive fields (tokens, keys, passwords, etc.) are redacted to "(redacted)" in state after read.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the format `namespace/name` (or `name` for cluster-scoped resources).
